title: Notice of Boyd Group Services Inc. 2026 First Quarter Results Conference Call
summary: Winnipeg, Manitoba – April 29, 2026 – Boyd Group Services Inc. (TSX:BYD; NYSE:BGSI) will release its fiscal 2026 first quarter results on May 13, 2026, before markets open. Following the release, Management of the Company will hold a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET to review the financial results. The call will be hosted by Brian Kaner, President and Chief Executive Officer; and Jeff Murray, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. All interested parties are invited to participate. CONFERENCE CALL DETAILS: DATE: Wednesday, May 13, 2026 TIME: 8:00 a.m. (ET) DIAL IN NUMBER: 1-800-715-9871 1-646-307-1963 WEBCAST LINK: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/980721311 CONFERENCE ID: 5533670 The call will also be webcast live and archived for 90 days on the Boyd Group’s website https://www.boydgroup.com .
